about_competition_body.zh: “國際桃李盃舞蹈大賽”由美國泛美舞蹈聯盟主辦，隆重推出業權威的評審團，他們的目光只為註視你而存在！在他們的關註和親切指導下，每位選手可以盡情演繹自我，用美妙的舞姿，展現人間的悲歡離合，可以揮灑對幸福、美好的渴望，歡呼和諧世界的進步與發展。
about_competition_body.en: The Taoli Cup Dance Competition was created by renowned dance educator Professor Pan Zhitao, who also founded the original Taoli Cup in China. The competition is organized by the Pan America Chinese Dance Alliance (PACDA). One of its most important goals is to discover and cultivate new talent.

about_history_title.zh: 一部舞蹈史詩，就是一部人類文明發展史。
about_history_title.en: A dance epic is a history of the development of human civilization.

about_history_body.zh: 中華舞蹈厚重精深，西方舞藝靈動曼妙。”國際桃李盃舞蹈大賽”，一個薈萃東方民族絕紗舞姿的舞臺，一個全面展示西方形體藝術的窗口，2015年在洛杉磯揭開大幕。這是東西方舞蹈藝術交融、碰撞的青少年國際舞蹈新品牌。
about_history_body.en: The competition also serves to showcase the achievements of dance instructors in both the U.S. and China, promote higher standards of teaching and performance, stimulate new dance creations, and advance the development of dance all over the world.

about_dialogue_body.zh: 來吧，舞者——到這裏向舞蹈藝術致以最誠摯的敬禮；來吧，舞者——到這裏與世界舞蹈藝術進行最友好的對話。
about_dialogue_body.en: The panel of judges assembled for this competition includes some of the most celebrated artists in the international dance community. Under their observation and guidance, the contestants can express themselves to the fullest.

about_touring_body.zh: “國際桃李盃舞蹈大賽”，給你一個夢想成真的機會。優秀的獲獎作品將有機會參加國際巡演，將舞蹈推向更廣闊的世界舞台！
about_touring_body.en: Through their dance, the contestants can tell stories of life’s ebb and flow, convey their desires for happiness, and celebrate progress toward greater harmony in the world. Selected dances from the regional competitions will advance to the final competition. Award-winning dances and groups will have opportunities to be invited to participate in national and international tours.

about_pacda_body.zh: 泛美舞蹈聯盟是一個在美國合法註冊的501(c)(3)非盈利組織。聯盟旨在傳承和發揚中華舞蹈文化，為協助在海外的舞蹈老師開展教育工作，並提供優質平臺給華人舞蹈愛好者，尤其為海外的下一代傳承中華舞蹈文化提供豐富資源及一個與時俱進的國際性舞蹈交流平臺。
about_pacda_body.en: Our mission is to promote Chinese dance art and creations, train Chinese dance teachers and professional dancers, provide a platform for dance competitions, master classes, and activities, enrich cultural life, and create opportunities for effective and substantive cross-cultural exchanges in the performing arts between Chinese dancers and teachers in the U.S. and dance professionals in China.
